name: A Tie in Hell
source:
Caswell Johnson is an accountant who dies when going to work. Instead of going to Heaven, he ends in Hell and has to work for the Devil!

[From [url=https://fflo.itch.io/a-tie-in-hell]itch.io[/url]]
